# @dxtmisha/figma-code

> Structured TypeScript abstraction layer for Figma Plugin main thread (backend) development.

Provides object-oriented wrappers around native Figma node APIs, persistent storage management with caching, and bidirectional messaging dispatch.

## Key Classes & Utilities

- [FigmaPluginMessenger](src/classes/FigmaPluginMessenger.ts): Main thread messaging singleton for posting and handling UI requests.
- [FigmaItem](src/classes/FigmaItem.ts): DOM-like wrapper for Figma nodes providing type checks, parent traversal, and property extraction.
- [FigmaFrame](src/classes/FigmaFrame.ts): Frame-specific wrapper for extracting layout properties, child hierarchies, and style tokens.
- [FigmaStorage](src/classes/FigmaStorage.ts): Node-level persistent storage (`setPluginData`) with memory caching and aging logic.
- [FigmaClientStorage](src/classes/FigmaClientStorage.ts): Plugin-level persistent storage (`figma.clientStorage`) wrapper.
- [FigmaAiText](src/classes/FigmaAiText.ts): Text analysis and extraction module for AI-driven localization and codegen workflows.

## Optional & AI Resources

- [ai-types.md](ai-types.md): Public TypeScript declarations and method signatures.
- [README.md](README.md): Backend plugin development guide and code examples.
